title: Document configurable statuses and add end-to-end regression coverage
description: Finish the project-facing contract for configurable statuses after CLI support lands. Update README, help text, and wtp schema output with the additionalStatuses JSON example, categories, timestamp and dependency semantics, generic set-status command, existing aliases, dynamic filters, and stats ordering/zero-bucket behavior. Replace hard-coded default-status expectations in shared test helpers, prerelease fixtures, and smoke/release checks only where dynamic behavior requires it, while retaining explicit tests that no-config projects still expose exactly the original four statuses and layout. Add integration coverage that opens a configured project, creates waiting/blocked/failed tasks, exercises list/graph/stats JSON and human output, verifies no-config compatibility, and fails safely when configuration removes a live state. Run go test ./... and the appropriate commit verification script.
